label: Bible Study
prompt: But ye, beloved, _____ up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
verse: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
note: Jude's construction advice — build yourselves up on your most holy faith.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the _____ of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.
verse: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.
note: Judah's orders: don't fight — stand still and watch. The enemy armies ended up turning on each other.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his _____ fell off from his hands.
verse: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
note: An angel woke Peter in prison with a smite on the side, and his chains simply fell off his hands.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the _____ that overcometh the world, even our faith.
verse: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
note: The world-beater isn't willpower — John says the victory that overcomes the world is faith itself.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the _____' den.
verse: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
note: In the peaceable kingdom a weaned child reaches into the 'cockatrice' den — the KJV's name for a deadly serpent.
